topic: Basketball fans perform an outrageous birth-scene distraction behind the hoop causing the opponent to miss a free throw.

hook.first_frame: Basketball student section fans wearing white holding a large white sheet in the stands.

shots.shows: Fans in white holding up a sheet in the crowd.
Referee getting ready to hand the ball to the player at the free throw line.
Fans lower the sheet to enact a fake childbirth scene in the stands.
Player #22 shoots the free throw and completely misses the shot.
Reaction clip of NBA player Jimmy Butler looking shocked at a piece of paper.

ending.last_frame: Jimmy Butler meme reaction looking intently at paper.

what_makes_it_work: Wild and funny crowd behavior creates instant viewer curiosity about what will happen.
Quick narrative arc showing the setup, execution, and successful result of the distraction.
Adding a recognizable meme reaction at the end emphasizes the comedy.
